versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֨נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּה֙ יוֹצֵ֣ר גֹּבַ֔י בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת עֲל֣וֹת הַלָּ֑קֶשׁ וְהִ֨נֵּה־לֶ֔קֶשׁ אַחַ֖ר גִּזֵּ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.
controles.kjv: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
controles.livre: Assim o Senhor DEUS me fez ver: eis que ele formava gafanhotos, no começo do crescimento da plantação tardia; e eis que era a plantação tardia, depois da colheita do rei.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־כִּלָּה֙ לֶֽאֱכוֹל֙ אֶת־עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ סְֽלַֽח־נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃

controles.web: When they made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord God, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando eles terminaram de comer a plantação da terra, eu disse: Senhor DEUS, perdoa, por favor; como Jacó poderá sobreviver?  Pois é pequeno.

versos.hebraico: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־זֹ֑את לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The Lord repented for this: It shall not be, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR se arrependeu disso: Isto não acontecerá,disse o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֨נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קֹרֵ֛א לָרִ֥ב בָּאֵ֖שׁ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וַתֹּ֨אכַל֙ אֶת־תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אֶת־הַחֵֽלֶק׃

controles.web: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me and behold, the Lord Yahweh called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.
controles.kjv: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord God called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
controles.livre: Assim o Senhor DEUS me fez ver: eis que o Senhor DEUS pretendeu executar juízo com fogo; e consumiu um grande abismo, assim como consumiu uma parte da terra.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ חֲדַל־נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Then I said, “Lord Yahweh, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
controles.kjv: Then said I, O Lord God, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
controles.livre: Então eu disse: Senhor DEUS, cessa, por favor; como Jacó poderá sobreviver? Pois é pequeno.

versos.hebraico: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־זֹ֑את גַּם־הִיא֙ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The Lord repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR se arrependeu disso: Isto também não acontecerá, disse o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֣ה הִרְאַ֔נִי וְהִנֵּ֧ה אֲדֹנָ֛י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־חוֹמַ֣ת אֲנָ֑ךְ וּבְיָד֖וֹ אֲנָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Thus he showed me and behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.
controles.kjv: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
controles.livre: Assim ele me fez ver: Eis que o Senhor estava sobre um muro que havia sido feito conforme o prumo, e havia um prumo em sua mão.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י מָֽה־אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲנָ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י הִנְנִ֨י שָׂ֤ם אֲנָךְ֙ בְּקֶ֨רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, “Amos, what do you see?”   I said, “A plumb line.”   Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the midst of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
controles.livre: E o SENHOR me disse: O que vês, Amós? E eu disse: Um prumo. Então o Senhor disse: Eis que eu porei um prumo no meio de meu povo Israel; não mais o tolerarei.

versos.hebraico: וְנָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יִשְׂחָ֔ק וּמִקְדְּשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יֶחֱרָ֑בוּ וְקַמְתִּ֛י עַל־בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃פ

controles.web: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”
controles.kjv: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
controles.livre: E os altos de idolatria de Isaque serão arruinados, e os santuários de Israel serão arruinados; e me levantarei com espada contra a casa de Jeroboão.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל אֶל־יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר קָשַׁ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ עָמ֗וֹס בְּקֶ֨רֶב֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־תוּכַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לְהָכִ֖יל אֶת־כָּל־דְּבָרָֽיו׃

controles.web: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.
controles.kjv: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth–el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
controles.livre: Então Amazias, o sacerdote de Betel, mandou mensagem a Jeroboão, rei de Israel, dizendo: Amós tem conspirado contra ti no meio da casa de Israel; o país  não poderá suportar todas as suas palavras.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר עָמ֔וֹס בַּחֶ֖רֶב יָמ֣וּת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
controles.kjv: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
controles.livre: Porque assim diz Amós: Jeroboão morrerá a espada, e Israel certamente será levado de sua terra em cativeiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָה֙ אֶל־עָמ֔וֹס חֹזֶ֕ה לֵ֥ךְ בְּרַח־לְךָ֖ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וֶאֱכָל־שָׁ֣ם לֶ֔חֶם וְשָׁ֖ם תִּנָּבֵֽא׃

controles.web: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
controles.kjv: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
controles.livre: Depois Amazias disse a Amós: Vidente, vai embora, e foge para a terra de Judá, e ali come o teu pão, e ali profetiza;

versos.hebraico: וּבֵֽית־אֵ֔ל לֹֽא־תוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לְהִנָּבֵ֑א כִּ֤י מִקְדַּשׁ־מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ ה֔וּא וּבֵ֥ית מַמְלָכָ֖ה הֽוּא׃ס

controles.web: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”
controles.kjv: But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el: for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.
controles.livre: Porém não profetizes mais em Betel, porque ali estão o santuário do rei, e o palácio real.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַן עָמוֹס֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־אֲמַצְיָ֔ה לֹא־נָבִ֣יא אָנֹ֔כִי וְלֹ֥א בֶן־נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי כִּֽי־בוֹקֵ֥ר אָנֹ֖כִי וּבוֹלֵ֥ס שִׁקְמִֽים׃

controles.web: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;
controles.kjv: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
controles.livre: Então Amós respondeu a Amazias: Eu não era profeta, nem filho de profeta; mas eu era criador de gado, e colhedor de frutos de sicômoros.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקָּחֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֔ה מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
controles.kjv: And the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
controles.livre: Porém o SENHOR me tomou do trabalho com o gado, e o SENHOR me disse: Vai, e profetiza a meu povo Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֗ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תַטִּ֖יף עַל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂחָֽק׃

controles.web: Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’
controles.kjv: Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
controles.livre: Agora pois, ouve a palavra do SENHOR. Tu dizes: Não profetizes contra Israel, nem fales contra a casa de Isaque.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֞ בָּעִ֤יר תִּזְנֶה֙ וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֨יךָ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְאַדְמָתְךָ֖ בַּחֶ֣בֶל תְּחֻלָּ֑ק וְאַתָּ֗ה עַל־אֲדָמָ֤ה טְמֵאָה֙ תָּמ֔וּת וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Therefore thus says Yahweh: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
controles.livre: Por isso, assim diz o SENHOR: Tua mulher se prostituirá na cidade, teus filhos e tuas filhas cairão à espada, e tua terra será repartida; tu morrerás em uma terra impura, e Israel será levado cativo de sua terra.
